The '''[[First of Mayene]]''' is the title of the ruler of [[Mayene]]. First styled as "First Lord" or "First Lady of Mayene," when [[Tyrn sur Paendrag Mashera]], grandson of [[Artur Paendrag Tanreall]] founded the city-state, it later dropped the Lord and Lady. However, when addressing a first, it is still common to call them "My Lord First" or "My Lady First."
